opening.argument: The presentation describes a Forsage BUSD plan in which joining and commissions are both conducted through BUSD, expressly stating that “the joining will be done through BUSB. and the commission will also come through BUSB.” It then sets out paid X3 and X4 slots, including a “matrix of 1 by 3” and a “2 by 4 matrix,” while tying earnings to network participation through sales, uplines, downlines, and crosslines. The plan promises percentage-based returns, including that “from these 7 balls, 70% will come,” alongside exceptionally large income and return examples without substantiation. Although it warns that money “may even be a loss,” that qualification addresses trading risk and does not qualify the separate joining-and-commission mechanism, which remains structured around recruitment commissions and tiered matrices.
